name: National Data Centre for North Eastern Region (NDC-NER) / NICSI Assam Data Centre
developer: National Informatics Centre (NIC) via NICSI, with Government of Assam / PWD (Building)
notes: Virtually inaugurated by PM Modi on 14 Feb 2026 at Amingaon, North Guwahati (Kamrup district). 8.5 MW sanctioned power / 4 MW IT load (initial 2 MW), 200-400 high-density racks, ~43,000 sq ft, Tier III with N+1 redundancy, IGBC Gold green DC, 70+ PB storage; serves all 8 NE states and forms part of the National Government Cloud (MeghRaj). Investment reported as Rs 348 crore by PMO/Sentinel; Baxtel and Bharatnet report the same NICSI project at over Rs 600 crore (~$71M, MeitY-funded).

name: CtrlS Guwahati Data Centre (Tech City Park)
notes: Rated-4 edge data centre at Tech City Park, Bongora, Guwahati (Kamrup district) on a 3-acre site; initial capacity ~1,000 racks expanding to 2,000+ racks over 12-18 months. Foundation stone reported laid (Biltrax, May 2022); Baxtel lists construction as initiated, but no recent completion news found - current status uncertain.

name: NCXHost Data Centre (North Guwahati)
notes: Small local edge/data-centre facility at Abhaypur, North Guwahati (Kamrup district); per Techno FAQ a ~1,200 sq ft flagship at Arya Smart Living, solar-powered showcase. Vendor claims of 'Assam's first public data centre' / Rated-4, Tier-III-inspired design are not verified by third-party sources; capacity not disclosed.

name: AMTRON Data Centre (Guwahati)
notes: State-government data centre at AMTRON HQ, Bamunimaidan, Guwahati (Kamrup Metropolitan district); operational since December 2012. Created as staging/testing centre for the Assam Online Portal and Secretariat Less Paper Office project; access restricted to state projects.

name: BSNL Data Centre Guwahati
notes: Announced 28 Sep 2025 by Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma: BSNL will set up data centres in five locations across India, one of them in Guwahati, as part of BSNL's nationwide digital/4G expansion. No site, capacity or timeline disclosed yet.

name: Reliance AI-Ready Data Centre (Assam)
notes: Announced by Mukesh Ambani at Advantage Assam 2.0 (25 Feb 2025) as part of a Rs 50,000 crore five-year Assam investment pledge; described as an AI-ready data centre supporting education, healthcare and agriculture. Exact site in Assam not disclosed; attributed to Kamrup Metropolitan (Guwahati) as the state's digital hub.

name: Four hyperscale data centres (Government of India plan)
developer: Government of India (DoT/MeitY initiative; no operator named)
notes: Union Telecom Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced at Advantage Assam 2.0 (25 Feb 2025) that the Centre plans Asia's four largest hyperscale data centres in Assam, totalling ~1 million sq ft, alongside 5G expansion; Rs 400 crore is being invested in state telecom/IT infrastructure. Statewide plan - no specific site or developer announced; attributed to Guwahati (Kamrup Metropolitan) as the hub.
